programmes.d: An ex-‘60s radical uses runaway kids to commit a rash of crimes.
Nash protects a beautiful rock star whose blood is covered by a group of modern-day vampires.
Nash must stop a sniper shooting victims at random; Evan proposes to Cassidy.
Nash and Joe are plunged into the underground world of steroid-crazed muscle men.
When the Governor is missing, Nash and Joe lead the “off-the-record”investigation.
A sleep-deprived Nash must track down an ingenious bomber targeting a corporation.
Nash and the SIU must re-open a serial killer’s case file when a body is discovered.
Nash and Joe investigate a missing hockey goalie connected to the Russian Mob.
When an ex-cop released from jail seeks revenge on Caitlin, Nash teams with her to capture him.
Nash and Joe track down a band of female bank robbers; Nick voluntarily moves into a nursing home.
The SIU is temporarily shut down and all are re-assigned after Caitlin deliversher report.
Nash and Joe track down three escaped convicts as the SIU is back as a guerilla unit.
Nash and the SIU crew plunge into the cutthroat world of media when a screen star is murdered.
When the boy is mistaken for the child of a restaurateur, Nash and the SIU track down kidnappers.
Nash must stop a ring of thieves who pose as firefighters; a rollerblader sues Nash.
A case of mistaken identity has Cassidy in trouble and Nash stumped as to who wants to harm her.
Caitlin gives Jake etiquette lessons after being put under cover to capture a felon.
Nash tracks down a pension accountant who has embezzled $7.3 million in city funds.
Nash and the SIU team investigate a string of robberies with nothing in common.
Nash and Joe are hired to protect a celebrity chimp from animal rights activists.
Nash and the SIU team track down a killer randomly targeting people talking on cellphones.
Nash tracks a vigilante hunting three murder suspects released on a technicality.
Nash and SIU investigate a crew specializing in ripping off other crews after pulling their jobs.
Nash puts Caitlin undercover to stop a thug from selling kidnapped Vietnamese women as slaves.
Nash assumes the identity of a hit man to expose a drug war between two rival kingpins.
When a woman falls to her death, it leads Nash into an investigation of the lives of the victim.
Nash fends off hit-men hired by Frankie Dwyer, who has returned in hopes of killing Nash.
Nash has to track down a cop impersonator on a rampage across the city.
